He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier Musketeers]]. ==High school career== Jones played basketball for [[Pinson Valley High School]] in [[Pinson, Alabama]]. As a sophomore, he averaged 23.9 points, 7.9 rebounds, and 3.9 assists per game. After a coaching change at Pinson, he transferred to [[Mountain Brook High School]] in [[Mountain Brook, Alabama]] for his junior season to play under coach [[Bucky McMillan]].{{cite web |last=Grant |first=Rubin E. |title=Along Came Jones: Talented, Thoughtful Junior Fits in Nicely With the Spartans |url=https://www.otmj.com/colby-jones-mbhs-basketball/ |website=Over the Mountain Journal |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=February 19, 2019}} Jones averaged 14 points, five rebounds and three assists per game as a junior.{{cite web |last=Bean |first=Josh |title=Alabama's top 2020 HS hoops prospect picks Big East school |url=https://www.al.com/recruiting/2019/08/alabamas-top-2020-hs-hoops-prospect-picks-big-east-school.html |website=AL.com |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=August 14, 2019}} He played alongside [[Trendon Watford]] and helped the school win its third straight Class 7A state title. In his senior season, Jones assumed a leading role and averaged 25.2 points, 7.8 rebounds, 3.2 assists, and 2.5 steals per game, helping Mountain Brook to a Class 7A runner-up finish.{{cite web |last=Grant |first=Rubin E. |title=2020 OTMJ All-OTM High School Boys Basketball Team: Jones Undergoes Life-Changing Experiences Playing for Mountain Brook |url=https://www.otmj.com/2020-otmj-all-otm-boys-basketball/ |website=Over the Mountain Journal |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}} He was named ''Over the Mountain Journal'' Player of the Year, All-South Metro Player of the Year and Alabama Class 7A Player of the Year.{{cite web |last=Parmley |first=Kyle |title=All-South Metro Team: Jones named Player of Year |url=https://www.villagelivingonline.com/sports/all-south-metro-team-jones-named-player-of-year/ |website=Village Living |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}}{{cite web |last=Thomas |first=Ben |title=Meet the state's 5 best boys HS basketball players for the 2019-2020 season |url=https://www.al.com/highschoolsports/2020/04/meet-the-states-5-best-boys-hs-basketball-players-for-the-2019-2020-season.html |website=AL.com |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=April 1, 2020}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]] over offers from [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]], [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]] and [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB]]. ==College career== Jones missed the first five games of his freshman season at Xavier due to [[COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19]] [[contact tracing]].{{cite web |last=Baum |first=Adam |title='Best hair on the team': Xavier freshman Colby Jones has emerged as an X-factor for the Musketeers |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/xaviersports/2021/01/08/xavier-freshman-colby-jones-has-emerged-major-x-factor/6578662002/ |website=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=January 8, 2021}} On January 10, 2021, he made a game-winning three-pointer in the final second of a 74–73 win against [[2020–21 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]].{{cite web |last=Baum |first=Adam |title=Xavier's Colby Jones hits a game-winner for his late grandfather |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/xaviersports/2021/01/10/big-east-battle-between-xavier-musketeers-providence-friars/6601557002/ |website=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=January 10, 2021}} On February 16, he scored a season-high 20 points and had six rebounds in a 93–84 loss to [[2020–21 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]].{{cite news |title=Champagnie scores 21 to lift St. John's past Xavier 93-84 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401269650 |access-date=October 24, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=March 1, 2021}} As a freshman, Jones averaged 7.7 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.9 assists per game, and was selected to the [[Big East]] All-Freshman Team.{{cite web |last=Eiser |first=Tom |title=Colby Jones Named To BIG EAST Conference All-Freshman Team |url=https://goxavier.com/news/2021/3/7/mens-basketball-colby-jones-named-to-big-east-conference-all-freshman-team.aspx |website=Xavier University Athletics |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=March 7, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Sacramento / Stockton Kings (2023–25)=== Jones was drafted 34th overall by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in the [[2023 NBA draft]]. During the draft, the [[Boston Celtics]] traded for his draft rights, and then subsequently traded him to the [[Sacramento Kings]] for the draft rights to [[Jordan Walsh]] and a 2024 second-round pick.{{cite news|first=Matt|last=Geagan|title=Celtics draft Jordan Walsh in second round, make four different trades on draft night|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/boston/news/celtics-draft-jordan-walsh-trade-back-four-times-2023-nba-draft-brad-stevens-bill-belichick/|website=CBSNews.com|access-date=June 28, 2023}} Throughout his rookie and sophomore seasons, he was [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] several times to the [[Stockton Kings]].{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Stockton Kings Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Stockton-Kings/56/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 29, 2024}}{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Stockton Kings Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Stockton-Kings/56/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 29, 2024}} Jones made 30 appearances for Sacramento during the [[2023–24 NBA season]], averaging 2.1 points, 1.3 rebounds, and 0.7 assists. Jones played in 39 contests for the Kings during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 1.1 points, 1.0 rebound, and 0.3 assists. ===Washington Wizards (2025)=== On February 6, 2025, Jones was traded to the [[Washington Wizards]] in a multi-team deal.{{cite web |url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/news/washington-acquires-marcus-smart-colby-jones-alex-len-and-a-first-round-pick-in-multi-team-trade |title=Washington Acquires Marcus Smart, Colby Jones, Alex Len, and a First-Round Pick In Multi-Team Trade |date=February 6, 2025 |work=NBA.com}} He made 15 appearances for the Wizards, averaging 8.7 points, 4.3 rebounds, and 2.5 assists. ===Detroit Pistons / Motor City Cruise (2025)=== On June 28, 2025, Jones was traded to the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] in exchange for [[Dillon Jones]] and a 2029 second-round pick. He was waived by the Thunder the same day.{{cite web |date=June 28, 2025 |title=Thunder Completes Trade With Washington Wizards |url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/trade-250628 |access-date=June 28, 2025 |work=NBA.com}} On July 29, Jones signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Detroit Pistons]].{{Cite web |date=July 29, 2025 |title=Detroit Pistons Sign Forward Colby Jones To a Two-Way Contract |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DMsxScHMGd6/?igsh=ZXUwN2lydHlrOW9q}} He made one appearance for the Pistons, recording two points and four rebounds in a 95–116 loss to the [[2025–26 Cleveland Cavaliers season|Cleveland Cavaliers]] on October 27. On November 10, Jones was waived by Detroit following the signing of [[Wendell Moore Jr.]]{{cite web | title=Wendell Moore Jr. signs Two-Way Contract with Detroit Pistons | website=The NBA G League | date=2025-11-11 | url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/wendell-moore-jr-signs-two-way-contract-with-detroit-pistons | access-date=2025-12-10}} On July 27, 2026, Jones signed with [[Bàsquet Manresa|Manresa]] of the [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{cite web | title=Colby Jones, versatilidad para Kids&Us Manresa | website=acb.com | date=2026-07-27 | url=https://www.acb.com/es/liga/noticias/colby-jones-versatilidad-para-kidsus-manresa-145686 | access-date=2026-07-27}} However, the club would later announce Jones' contract was terminated due to medical reasons.{{cite web | title=Colby Jones no fichará por Kids&Us Manresa | website=acb.com | date=2026-08-07 | url=https://www.acb.com/es/liga/noticias/colby-jones-no-fichara-por-kidsus-manresa-145745 | access-date=2026-08-07}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== {{NBA player
